notes.title: Whoops I Forgot To Update Didn't I?
notes.content:
Hey! Long time huh?
I know, I know... I didn't update this place in a while and you must be worried sick:

[i]"How is that 'Do Not Buy This Game' guy doing these days? Is he taking care of himself? Does he eat properly?"[/i]

So let's put your worries to rest - YES, I'M ALIVE.
And while I don't find the time to update, and while there is still a time until the game will be ready, I have been working hard on the game every day.
Things are progressing well, and I'm always excited to think about your reactions when you'll get to experience the weird journey I'm creating for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37571737/963e9b8f2b4a79ec7caa2b4813c00799cf908280.png[/img]

[h1]Let's talk about the demo update[/h1]

First things first - I'm an idiot. Apparently I forgot to add Traditional Chinese even though it's been ready for a LONG while now.
So HUGE thanks to John HY Au for this translation (and I AM SO SORRY AHH-)

Also, some wonderful people in my discord decided to translate the demo to Polish!
Thank you Bitowsky, Marcin Pilarski, and Jod Emperor Kaczyński for your awesome contribution 

I hope this will help even more people to experience the game in their preferred language.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
And last and least important, I try not to meddle with the demo too much because it doesn't share the same tech-stack with the main game, but there are some bugs that kept bothering me (and new players) that I just had to fix:
[list]
[*]No more annoying noise when walking with your face toward the wall
[*]MAYBE MAYBE MAYBE you won't be able to fall down the stairs anymore?? (I don't know how people managed to do it anyway, but I did my best to make it as impossible as I can)
[/list]

notes.title: Bitsummit + Japanese Translation!
notes.content:
So let's get right to it - If you're going to Bitsummit in Kyoto tomorrow, go ahead and check out the booth for Do Not Buy This Game 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37571737/644518a1ea56f19ba00786753d6e8c8f579ff564.jpg[/img]

So to make sure the demo was ready for Bitsummit, I partnered up with PrismaLoc again to translate the demo to Japanese 🙌
Thank you very much to Rie Nogawa and Soichiro Arai for working so hard on the translation!!

And for those of you that do not speak Japanese, I've taken some extra time to try and optimize the demo a bit, so it hopefully should run a bit smoother 🏄‍♀️

The full game is still very much in development, but good things are happening behind the scenes. Look forward to it.

So until next time, have an amazing day everyone!

notes.title: Some madman played the demo for 1000 hours...?!
notes.content:
I couldn't believe they would actually do it, but a few months ago a very nice user called "¿" came to the Steam forums and made [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1158190/discussions/0/2952663522494546981/]a post asking me to release the game if they will play the demo for 100 hours[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37571737/c0eb0d3a3ed72d06f40c5035932ce3d81223938d.png[/img]

I had to respond accordingly, because no matter how hard you press the demos "Play" button, unfortunately the game won't magically be ready.

That didn't stop "¿"!
You have to understand, the demo is AT MOST 20 minutes long. It's linear, the experience doesn't repeat itself!
But he [url=http://discord.gg/MAEKSXY]joined my discord[/url] anyway, now known as "1911", and played the demo for these 100 hours, and at the end of this journey wrote down this message:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37571737/8ef6ea5f024d1bc0189c3c40fa8addb4ea0d8c7c.png[/img]

This was genuinely heartwarming. He challenged himself and completed the challenge in order to help do something incredibly nice to me and the game!

But he wasn't the only one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37571737/3f72772b27f8c91628cd08b8e7602353f7160f0d.png[/img]

There came Kiwis (Omar Ajez) and came up with this redicoulus idea.
I sat there from the other side of the screen, and figured out there's just no way someone will play the demo for 1000 hours.
It's 41 days of non-stop playing!!!
This is crazy. No way.

But they did it.
Yesterday I came back to my discord to find this message:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37571737/29a3f47955709f0d7798bcf2cea86844e3845e30.png[/img]

I honestly forgot about it, but there it was.
One THOUSAND hours of gameplay on my little weird demo.

So as I've said beforehand, I had to do SOMETHING.
I sat down to think about it and decided to give both "¿" and Omar an easter egg in the full game.

So yeah, thank you to both of you, you've made me really happy with how much you care about my game. I hope you'll like your easter egg when you get to see it for yourselves 😊

And for everyone else that read so far, thank you for your support as well!
The game still has some way to go before I'll actually be able to release it, but I'm working hard on making it something special that I hope you will love.

In the meantime, if you'd like, you can join me and the rest of these crazy fellows at [url=http://discord.gg/MAEKSXY]the game's discord server[/url]. Everyone in there is the best kind of crazy that you can ask for 😉

notes.title: Release Date...?
notes.content:
Hey there, how are you doing? I've been doing pretty good lately!
I moved, refurnished my apartment... and... all sort of exciting stuff!

... What? The gif below this text is distracting you?
No don't pay attention to it, it's nothing important or anything-

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37571737/8a3543bcf0abc0d779f762d25f0f866c4b1a7207.gif[/img]

Oh yeah. Delaying the game release. Right.
So I guess I kind of need to explain, don't I?

I don't know if you ever got the chance, but creating stuff can be pretty hard to do (ESPECIALLY when you mostly do it alone). I tried really hard to actually finish this by the time I wished to release the game but... well... there is SO MUCH left to do.

So instead of creating something that is mediocre and probably buggy just to sort-of-make-it in time for release, I decided delaying the game to when it's ready for you not to buy it would be a far superior choice.
So I'm delaying it until it will reach such a point.
Will it take half a year?
A YEAR?!
12 EXTRA HOURS?!

I don't know. I wish I knew but I unfortunately don't.
If you'd like to stay updated on everything, you can [url=https://mailchi.mp/bbe8d0427ba7/donotbuythisgame]join the mailing list[/url] / [url=http://discord.gg/MAEKSXY]discord[/url], and I'll be sure to update you there, no matter how long it takes.

In the meantime, thank you very much for supporting me and this weird WEIRD game I'm making. Knowing there's a lot of you out there expecting it to be a great experience brings me tremendous amounts of joy, and I am doing my best to create something that we all can be proud of.

Much love,
The developer.
